NLO_argument: Top QCD corrections replace the transverse-current kernel while retaining the same fixed weak-coupling factors. Thus Gamma_leptonic_i=B_l*Gamma_BW_i for i=0,1 with the matched convolution and a fixed external GammaW. This is an algebraic argument, not an independent NLO integration.
scope: Stable-ttW branching comparison extends to top-bw with an on-shell associated W. It does not extend to all-bw production. No extra branching factor is applied to events. The generator narrow-W and virtuality-support tests remain separate.
